Fetch simulated critical values for a given (n, lag), disk-cached

Source: R/crit-bucket.R
fetch_crit_bucket.Rd

Checks a persistent local cache first (survives across sessions), then the bucket proxy. Returns NULL (rather than erroring) if neither has it, so callers can fail gracefully.

Usage

fetch_crit_bucket(n, lag = 0, base_url = crit_bucket_base_url)
